G001.target_statement: Check the next day's temperature before going out in order to decide whether to wear a thick or a light coat.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句明确说明通常在前一天查温度，用于决定穿厚外套还是薄外套，主体、对象、结果与时间均一致。

G002.target_statement: Skip cycling and take the bus instead when the weather is very cold.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原句以条件句明确表达很冷时可能放弃自行车改坐公交；目标保留条件与方式，未把 might 强化为必须。
supported_parts: 方式替换：自行车改公交

G003.target_statement: Check the rain forecast and make sure to carry an umbrella when rain is forecast.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句直接说明会查降雨预报并在有雨时确保带伞，动作与结果一致。

G004.target_statement: When first opening the app, look at the temperature and at tomorrow's chance of rain before anything else.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 回答“打开后先看什么”时直接给出温度与明日降雨概率两项，目标保留“先看”的优先级含义。
supported_parts: 两项信息：温度、明日降雨概率

G005.target_statement: Check the next day's hour-by-hour forecast, focused on the temperature and precipitation chance around the morning time before classes when actually going out.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 两段原句分别给出小时级查看、时段聚焦（上课前/出门时）与降水概率判断；合并为同一查看动作的两个参数，未改变 25% 阈值含义。

G006.target_statement: Be warned by the app about severe weather events affecting his own city, so he notices them.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句明确说应用会给出警告，且本市发生事件时一定会注意到；目标保留“本市”范围，未扩展到全球事件。

G007.target_statement: On receiving a typhoon alert, open the notification and check the severity and all the details provided.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 针对“收到台风警报后先做什么”的回答直接给出打开通知、看严重程度与详情，主体与条件一致。

G008.target_statement: Read the recommendations from local authorities or the government meteorological organization to decide whether to evacuate, seek shelter, stay inside, or just carry an umbrella and raincoat.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句明确会读官方建议并列出可选项；目标保留“取决于严重程度”的开放选择，不替其选定某一方式。
supported_parts: 选项包含撤离、避难、不外出、仅带雨具

G009.target_statement: Adjust the day's plans based on the severity and the information given in the warning.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句直接说明依据严重程度与所给信息调整当天安排，条件与结果明确。

G010.target_statement: Start checking the weather as soon as a trip is decided, using historical data or future/monthly forecasts to get a good estimate of the expected weather.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句说明一旦确定出行就立即查历史数据或未来/月度预报以取得估计；两种方式以“或”保留，未强化为同时使用。
supported_parts: 历史数据或未来/月度预报

G011.target_statement: Check cloud coverage when planning a trip and reconsider or cancel if it will be overcast, for example a beach vacation or an astronomical event trip.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句以海滩度假为例说明云量会导致重新考虑；天文观测的取消在后续同段原句亦有依据，属于同一目的的示例而非新增要求。

G012.target_statement: Defer the final go/no-go decision on a trip until about two or three days before, when the forecast is more accurate, and then decide based on the final forecast.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 两段原句共同说明临近日期预报更准、应等到最后两三天再据最终预报决定；保留“可能/大概”的建议强度。

G013.target_statement: Plan to screenshot temperature readings below zero and share them on social media.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原句明确说计划很快这么做，并给出触发条件（低于 0 度）；目标以“plan to”保留尚未执行的计划状态。
supported_parts: 截图并分享到社交媒体

G014.target_statement: Prefer a plain black or plain white background over the current dull blue colour scheme.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句明确不喜欢暗蓝色背景并说更偏好纯黑或纯白；作为偏好保留，未升格为强制要求。

G015.target_statement: Avoid pages crowded with four or five ads, including video ads, so the weather can still be checked quickly without distraction.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句直接说明 4-5 个广告加视频广告过多、分散注意力并破坏快速查看的体验；保留可接受 1-2 个广告的边界。
supported_parts: 4-5 个广告含视频广告过多

G016.target_statement: Make the layout more compact so related information sits closer together and is easier to read.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句提出可以把 UI 压紧、让内容彼此靠近以便阅读；建议以 maybe 表达，目标保留为建议强度而非强制。

G017.target_statement: Consider paying for the ad-free/premium tier only if daily use exceeds 20-30 minutes or the radar section improves substantially; at current usage it is not required.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原句分别给出两个触发条件（每日使用超过 20-30 分钟、雷达做好）与当前“不需要”的结论；合并为同一付费决策的两个条件，未把可能购买写成已决定购买。
supported_parts: 当前用量下不需要付费
用量超过 20-30 分钟才考虑
雷达显著改善才考虑购买

G018.target_statement: Improve the radar section into a much more detailed, intuitive multi-parameter map (snow coverage, precipitation) with animated visuals.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句明确说雷达可以更好、并指出多参数（雪、降水）与直觉化地图的方向；动画偏好来自其对 windy.com 的描述，作为同一雷达改进的内容保留。

G019.target_statement: View temperatures in Celsius rather than the Fahrenheit default.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 原句直接表达偏好摄氏度，并说明当前默认是华氏度；保留偏好强度。

G020.target_statement: Keep weather.com notifications off, consistent with a general preference for no notifications.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原句明确偏好无通知且已保持关闭；目标保留“通常/偏好”的强度，未写成对所有设备一律禁止。

G021.target_statement: Prefer that location data stay in the local browser cache and be clearable, rather than be stored and be able to identify his city in a leak.
G021.label: inferred
G021.rationale: 受访者未直接提出要求，但以“本地缓存可清除、不必担心被存储”为安心理由，并对登录后泄露可识别城市表示担忧，可正向推断其偏好位置数据留在本地、不被服务端存储或与身份关联；强度为轻微担忧，未写成硬性要求。
supported_parts: 对本地缓存可清除的安心
对登录后泄露可识别城市的担忧
assumptions: 受访者的安心与担忧可合理读作对数据存放位置的偏好
reasoning_steps: 从“不必担心被存储”推断希望不被存储
从泄露可识别城市推断希望不与身份关联

G022.target_statement: Have very local weather data for specific non-city places such as hiking trails, a hotel in the middle of nowhere, or a mountain climbing route.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句明确说城市级信息在此情境无用、非常本地的数据会有帮助；目标保留非城市地点的适用范围与示例。
supported_parts: 示例：步道、登山、偏远酒店
